title: Wellness Membership: One Membership per Member
content:
Each member holds one Wellness Membership, whatever its tier.

## The rule

A member holds at most 1 Wellness Membership. A new membership is not opened while the member holds one that is pending start, active, frozen, past due or pending cancellation; a different tier is reached by a tier change instead.

## Basis of the decision

- The decision rests on the company's membership records for that member, the member on record and the status of each of their memberships, as they stand before the new membership would be opened. It does not rest on the caller's description of what they hold.
- The memberships considered are those recorded for the same member who would hold the new one.

## Status by status

| Status of a membership the member already holds | A new membership is opened? |
|---|---|
| Pending start | No |
| Active | No |
| Frozen | No |
| Past due | No |
| Pending cancellation | No |

A membership in cancelled status is not one of the five statuses in this table.

## Hypothetical situations

- A member holding an active Wellness Essentials Membership who wants the Wellness Plus Membership instead: no second membership is opened; the different tier is reached by a tier change on the existing membership.
- A member whose Open Gym Access Membership is frozen and who asks to join the Aquatic Access Membership: the frozen membership is one of the listed statuses, so a new membership is not opened.
- A member whose cancellation notice has been given and has not yet taken effect holds a membership pending cancellation, one of the listed statuses, so a new membership is not opened while it remains so.
